title: Draw ObjectJointUser by a graphicsDataUserFunction, and the joints of UserItemCreator as the built-in joints
author: Claude-JG
description: ObjectJointUser draws nothing, so the revolute, prismatic, spherical and distance joints of UserItemCreator (#3140) are invisible and their drawing arguments are accepted and not used. A graphicsDataUserFunction as ObjectConnectorUser has (#3119), and the drawings of the built-in joints from the drawing arguments.
releaseNotes: ObjectJointUser has a graphicsDataUserFunction, as ObjectConnectorUser; the revolute, prismatic, spherical and distance joints of UserItemCreator are drawn by it - a cylinder along the axis, a sphere, a line - with their drawing arguments
